description: Source code for the IsochronousClockModel class, implementing clock synchronization and drift correction for audio streams in Android.

classes.name: IsochronousClockModel
classes.description: Manages clock synchronization, timestamp processing, drift correction, and histogram logging for audio streams.

methods.name: setPositionAndTime
methods.description: Sets the current frame position and timestamp.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the clock model at a given start time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the clock model and logs maximum lateness and DSP stalls.

methods.name: isStarting
methods.description: Checks if the model is in starting state.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the model is in running state.

methods.name: processTimestamp
methods.description: Processes incoming timestamp and frame position, updates clock state, and handles drift correction.

methods.name: driftForward
methods.description: Adjusts the clock forward to account for lateness or jitter.

methods.name: setSampleRate
methods.description: Sets the audio sample rate and updates timing calculations.

methods.name: setFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Sets the number of frames per burst and updates timing parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Recalculates timing thresholds based on sample rate and frames per burst.

methods.name: convertDeltaPositionToTime
methods.description: Converts frame delta to time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: convertDeltaTimeToPosition
methods.description: Converts time delta in nanoseconds to frame position.

methods.name: convertPositionToTime
methods.description: Converts frame position to timestamp in nanoseconds.

methods.name: convertTimeToPosition
methods.description: Converts timestamp in nanoseconds to frame position.

methods.name: getLateTimeOffsetNanos
methods.description: Returns the maximum measured lateness offset in nanoseconds.

methods.name: convertPositionToLatestTime
methods.description: Converts frame position to latest estimated timestamp considering lateness.

methods.name: convertLatestTimeToPosition
methods.description: Converts timestamp to frame position considering lateness offset.

methods.name: dumpHistogram
methods.description: Outputs histogram data of timestamp lateness.
